document: Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines. These machines are designed to think, learn, and make decisions like humans. AI systems can be classified into three types: Narrow AI, General AI, and Super AI.

AI systems can be classified into three types: Narrow AI, General AI, and Super AI. Narrow AI is designed to perform a specific task such as facial recognition or voice assistants. General AI aims to perform any intellectual task that a human can do.

generation.

standalone vector indexes may require a full re-indexing process to incorporate 
new data, which can be time-consuming and computationally expensive.
